# runpod_cpu_types (Data Source)

CPU flavors offered by Runpod, from the catalog API. The flavor ids feed runpod_pod.cpu_type_id for a CPU-only pod and runpod_serverless_endpoint.cpu for a CPU-only endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runpod_cpu_types" "all" {}

output "cpu_ids" {
  description = "CPU flavor identifiers."
  value       = [for c in data.runpod_cpu_types.all.cpu_types : c.id]
}
```

Complete, runnable configurations that use this data source live in the
use-case modules under `v2/modules/` in the provider repository; the Guides
section documents each one.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `cpu_types` (Attributes List) All CPU flavors with their specs and pricing. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cpu_types))

<a id="nestedatt--cpu_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cpu_types`

Read-Only:

- `group` (String) Flavor group.
- `id` (String) CPU flavor identifier.
- `name` (String) Human-readable CPU name.
- `price_secure_per_vcpu` (Number) Secure cloud price in USD/hr per vCPU.
- `price_serverless_per_vcpu` (Number) Serverless price in USD/hr per vCPU.
- `ram_gb_per_vcpu` (Number) RAM in GB per vCPU.
- `vcpu_max` (Number) Maximum vCPU count.
- `vcpu_min` (Number) Minimum vCPU count.
